purpose: Freeze the v1.2.18 Agent/RAG starting point before the reliability remediation. Functional metrics are reproducible by their named command; performance values are single-run observations, not cross-machine targets. This record contains only closed metrics, test identifiers, error codes and source paths; it contains no user notes, prompts, credentials, URLs or tool arguments.

deterministicRag.vectorMode: disabled by the test; this is an FTS/metadata/scope/rank/ContextPacket baseline, not a sqlite-vec quality claim

metrics.warmP95Interpretation: single-run local observation; it varies by machine and process and is not a release threshold

agentSmoke.reproduction: The encrypted-credential child test reliably fails with the selected local LLM/MCP transports, while invoking the Rust test without IRIS_AGENT_EVAL_CREDENTIAL_PROBE=1 is a no-op and is not evidence that the credential-hydration pilot passes.
agentSmoke.triage: Stage 0 records this as a release blocker. A later TDD task must preserve the real encrypted-credential isolation assertion and make all 24 interaction-matrix cases terminal and passing; it must not relax the expected count or mark external failures as success.

securityAudit.rootAdvisory: GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 in brace-expansion through minimatch and the ESLint/TypeScript-eslint development dependency chain
securityAudit.triage: This is a release blocker. A later dependency task must update, replace, isolate or explicitly time-bound the affected development dependency chain; it must not lower npm audit severity or suppress the finding without a maintainer-approved security decision.

confirmedStartingConditions: retrieval_broker/graph.rs reads confirmed block_links although the Markdown indexer writes links
embedding/engine.rs returns an empty semantic result when chunk_embeddings_v2 exceeds MAX_COSINE_FALLBACK_CHUNKS (8000)
embedding_generation_ready requires global generation completeness, so a changed document can make usable existing vectors unavailable
indexer/chunker.rs can carry a short pre-heading chunk into the next heading and assign the new heading path
the default packaging and CI paths do not prove all-platform sqlite-vec retrieval quality
nonClaims: The deterministic RAG result does not prove vector recall, vector latency, semantic entailment or a calibrated citation model.
A source group proves only source binding for an uncalibrated route; it does not prove every visible claim is semantically supported.
This snapshot does not authorize a remote vector database, an HTTP provider endpoint, a reranking service or a long-term memory subsystem.
